name: Courtline Glide 26 Indoor Pickleballs
description: The Courtline Glide 26 is a premium indoor ball designed for gym floors and indoor courts. Its 26 larger holes and softer one-piece seamless construction slow the ball down and produce a quieter, more controllable bounce on smooth wooden or synthetic surfaces. The bright optic yellow color stays visible under gymnasium lighting.
care_instructions: Store at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Indoor balls soften and lose bounce over time; replace when the ball feels mushy or no longer bounces consistently.
